name: add_stock
description: Stage stock-in for one or more products (needs user confirm). Resolve each productId via search_product first. Supports multi-line intake (product A from person X, product B from person Y) in one call via items[]. Optional sourceName is the person/supplier name for display only. Does not post until confirmed. Preview shows currentStock, adding, finalStock per line.

sourceName.description: Who stock came from (person/supplier name). Display only — not a supplier id.

currentStock.description: Current available qty from search_product.stock if known

purchasePrice.description: Cost per unit. Use product cost/sellingPrice when user did not give one.

name: bill_summary
description: Supplier purchase bill analytics: total bills, paid bills, pending/overdue bills, and payable/paid/due amounts.

name: cashbook_summary
description: Daily and periodic cashbook summary: cash in/out, opening/closing balance, and day status.

name: create_collect_link
description: Stage a payment collect link for a customer (needs confirm). Optional amount; omit to collect full due.

name: create_customer
description: Create customer (name + either phone or email from user). Never invent name/phone/email/ids.

phone.description: Indian 10-digit mobile number (required if email omitted)

name: create_expense
description: Record a new expense for the store (e.g. rent, electricity, tea/refreshments, salaries, maintenance, delivery, supplies). Requires user confirmation before execution.

title.description: Short description of expense (e.g. 'Store Rent', 'Electricity bill', 'Chai nashta')

category.description: Expense category value. Valid values: 'daily-expenses' (Tea & Snacks / Chai / nashta / food), 'rent' (Rent / Kiraya), 'transport' (Delivery / Transport / Fuel / Dhulai), 'staff-wages' (Salary / Wages / Pagar), 'utilities' (Electricity / Water / Bijli), 'shop-supplies' (Bags / Packaging), 'office-supplies' (Stationery), 'maintenance' (Repairs), 'marketing', 'miscellaneous'

description.description: Optional professional description or note for the expense (e.g. 'Electricity bill for September 2026'). Intelligently formulate from user context.

status.description: Optional payment status: 'PAID' (already paid / cleared, e.g. 'bill bhra'), 'PENDING' (yet to pay), or 'OVERDUE'. Default is 'PAID' if paid, else 'PENDING'.

name: create_invoice_draft
description: Create DRAFT invoice only (no stock deduct). Items need real product ObjectIds + qty>=1; optional customerId (else walk-in).

name: create_purchase_order
description: Draft a purchase order to order inventory from a supplier. Requires supplierId, items with productId and quantity. Requires user confirmation before execution.

name: customer_detailed_analytics
description: Detailed periodic customer analytics (growth, acquisition, order frequency) over 7, 15, or 30 days.

name: customer_dossier
description: Who someone is: one customer match plus their saved memo, dues if present, and up to 10 recent bills. Not a biography.

query.description: Customer name, phone, or email search text

name: customer_summary
description: Store customer totals: total customers, today new, and new customers in last 7/15/30 days (and longer windows). Set periodDays for detailed period analytics (growth, averages).

periodDays.description: Optional lookback for detailed customer analytics. Omit for all-time totals + new-customer windows.

name: expense_summary
description: Store expense summary totals and category breakdown.

name: get_customer_ledger
description: Standalone khata ledger lines for one customer (running balance, type, amount). Prefer this over search_customer ledger slice when the user asks for ledger history.

name: get_customer_payment
description: Fetch one customer payment by payment ObjectId.

name: gst_summary
description: GST summary (taxable value, IGST, CGST, SGST, total tax) and GST compliance health score.

name: inventory_velocity
description: Deterministic inventory sales velocity and scanning: correlates catalog stock against observed sales to identify fast-moving products and items with zero sales observed in the scanned window.

name: invoice_detailed_analytics
description: Macro trend analytics (revenue trend, growth rates, status breakdown) over a multi-day window (7, 15, or 30 days). For specific day sales or bills (e.g. kal, aaj, or a specific date), use list_invoices or today_sale instead.

name: invoice_summary
description: Invoice/bill counts and amounts. Returns all-time totals, today's invoices, and optionally a period window (periodDays=7/15/30) for last N days invoice count/revenue.

periodDays.description: Optional lookback window in days. Use 7 for last week, 30 for last month. Omit for all-time + today only.

name: ledger_credit
description: Stage customer PAYMENT (khata credit) for user confirm. Real customerId and amount. Does not post until confirmed.

name: ledger_debit
description: Stage customer DEBIT on khata (increases due) for user confirm. Real customerId and amount. Does not post until confirmed.

name: list_customer_accounts
description: List customer khata accounts (dues/advance). Use hasDue=true for customers with outstanding balance.

hasDue.description: If true, only accounts with dues

name: list_expenses
description: List recent expenses with title, category, amount, payment mode, and date. Capped at 20.

name: list_invoices
description: List invoices/bills with invoiceNumber, customer, date/time (IST), totalAmount, totalProfit, and paymentStatus. Use startDate and endDate (YYYY-MM-DD) to get invoices for a specific calendar day (e.g. yesterday 'kal', today 'aaj', or past dates).

limit.description: Max invoices to return (default 20, capped at 50)

name: list_payment_reminders
description: List payment reminders sent for this store (optional customerId filter).

name: list_purchase_orders
description: List purchase orders (PO) with PO number, supplier, status, date, and amount. Capped at 20.

status.description: PO status filter (e.g. DRAFT, PENDING, APPROVED, RECEIVED, CANCELLED)

name: list_sales_orders
description: List customer sales orders with order number, customer, status, payment status, and total amount. Capped at 20.

status.description: Order status (PENDING, CONFIRMED, SHIPPED, DELIVERED, CANCELLED)

name: list_staff
description: List store staff and team members with name, phone, role, and active status.

name: list_stores
description: List accessible stores with name, category, subCategories, and which is active. Use for store name, category, count, or which products/categories fit THIS store — never guess category from the store name alone.

name: merge_customers
description: Stage merge of duplicate customer into primary (needs confirm). Pass real primaryId + duplicateId from search_customer. Duplicate is soft-deactivated.

name: payment_history
description: Recent customer payments for this store. Not one customer's ledger lines.

name: payment_mix
description: Deterministic breakdown of store payment collections by channel (Cash, UPI, Card, Credit/Udhaar, Bank Transfer) over a time window (today, 7d, 30d).

name: product_summary
description: How many products are listed/created in the catalog (total, active, inactive) — includes products with zero stock. Use for 'total products' / 'kitne product listed'.

name: record_customer_payment
description: Stage a structured customer payment (needs confirm). Use for formal payment entries with method/type. For quick khata jama prefer ledger_credit. paymentType: LEDGER_PAYMENT | INVOICE_PAYMENT | ADJUSTMENT | REFUND.

invoiceId.description: Required for INVOICE_PAYMENT if no allocations

name: release_invoice
description: Stage DRAFT release (stock deduct); needs user confirm. Real draft invoice ObjectId only.

name: sales_pareto
description: Deterministic 80/20 Pareto product sales analysis: calculates top revenue-generating products, units sold, and cumulative revenue shares from verified invoices over a time window (today, 7d, 30d).

name: search_customer
description: Find a customer by name, phone, or email. Basic result is name, phone, email, and active status. Address, GST, khata totals, and ledger lines are added only when the user asked for that part.

query.description: Customer name, phone, or email search text

name: search_product
description: Search live products by name/SKU (price, stock, status).

name: search_supplier
description: Search suppliers/vendors by name, company, phone, or GST number.

query.description: Supplier name, phone, or company search text

name: send_payment_reminder
description: Stage a payment reminder to a customer (needs confirm). channel defaults to EMAIL (SMS/WHATSAPP may be unavailable).

name: set_opening_balance
description: Stage opening khata balance for a customer who has no account yet (needs confirm). Never use for file import or bulk. Pass customerId + totalDue and/or totalPaid.

name: stock_items
description: Itemized inventory stock rows across products and variants (name, SKU, stock quantity, stock status, purchase & selling prices). Capped at 30 items.

includeServices.description: Include service items without physical stock

name: stock_summary
description: Inventory/stock totals only (qty on hand, low/out of stock). Not the count of listed products — use product_summary for how many products are created/listed.

name: store_brief
description: Deterministic composite executive store brief: combines live sales today, inventory stock alerts, customer receivables/dues, and expenses into a single verified report.

date.description: Optional date in YYYY-MM-DD format (defaults to today)

name: supplier_summary
description: Supplier analytics: total suppliers count and total payable/due amounts.

name: today_sale
description: Today's live sales: revenue, profit, bill count.

name: top_customers
description: Customers who spent the most in up to 50 recent released bills.

name: update_customer
description: Update customer by real ObjectId. Always send name + phone or email (Core requires them). Optional: note, companyDetails (GST), addresses (billing/shipping). Resolve via search_customer first. Not for delete/bulk.

phone.description: Indian 10-digit mobile number (required if email omitted)

name: update_customer_payment
description: Stage update of payment notes only (needs confirm). Cannot change amount/method.

name: update_expense
description: Update an existing expense by its expenseId (e.g. change payment status to 'OVERDUE', 'PAID', 'PENDING', or 'CANCELLED', update amount, title, category, date, or description/note). Only provide fields to update.

expenseId.description: Existing expense ObjectId from prior context or search

amount.description: Optional updated expense amount in INR (> 0)

name: update_invoice_draft
description: Update existing DRAFT: link customer and/or replace items. Prefer this over a second draft for the same bill.
